mission: Build a fractal Google Maps of law for Swiss Federal Supreme Court case law from 2000 onward plus user-imported corpora, beating simple semantic-map baselines in legal usefulness.

corpus.question: Scale the canonical TF-2000+ acquisition/normalization pipeline from 1000 decisions to full coverage. Implement robust user corpus import with schema validation and map artifact persistence.

legal-distance.question: Test which legally structured signals (norms/articles at issue, reasoning sections, citation roles, legal issues, outcomes, doctrine citations) improve nearest-neighbor legal relevance over the validated debiased_citation_blended baseline while suppressing procedural boilerplate.
human_decision_options: (a) enforce deadline with auto-status-change to BLOCKED if no ACCEPTED evidence by next director cycle
(b) reallocate resources from other lanes to unblock legal-distance
(c) change lane status to BLOCKED pending explicit human decision on continuation

fractal-map.question: Productize the multi-resolution hierarchical Leiden map for user-facing zoom/navigation: expose resolution ladder, cluster metadata, and legal coherence at each zoom level; validate that zoom reveals legally actionable substructure.

evaluation.question: Extend evaluation to v2: jurist usability studies, Jurivoc descriptor integration, scale benchmarks for full corpus, and adversarial tests for representation stability under corpus growth and cross-language transfer.

product.question: Complete the ugly-but-real vertical slice: persist user-imported map artifacts, add map export, integrate legal-distance signals as selectable map modes, and harden the corpus-to-map pipeline for TF base map plus user imports.

director_note: Evaluation lane v1 COMPLETE (14/14 benchmarks PASS on debiased_citation_blended n_pca=1 alpha=0.7). Fractal-map lane validated: hierarchical Leiden nesting consistency 1.0, zoom coherence +7.1%, branch purity improves at finer resolutions. Product lane has 90-test vertical slice with evaluation integration. Legal-distance lane HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED — UNTESTED for >=5 cycles, audit-mandated escalation with explicit options (a/b/c). Corpus at 1000-decision slice; needs full TF 2000+ scale. v2 shifts from validation to productization and legal-signal enrichment.
